comment: Size, start-up and memory budgets of Krate Native, checked by TestNativeBudgetSizes and TestNativeBudgetGUI in packages/compiler/internal/build. Each entry holds the value that was measured and the limit (measured plus headroom). To update after an intended change: run the tests with KRATE_UPDATE_BUDGETS=1 (see packages/native/BUDGETS.md), review the diff and commit it.
